name: No Results for Elementor
author: stixen84

sections.description:
This plugin helps you modify the Elementor search results page when there are no results found. By default Elementor only gives you a message box to change.

With this plugin you can add more to it such as a title, text and a search input box.

*** Pro Version with more features available ***

  • Text alignments
  • Text colors
  • Font sizes for mobile, tablet and desktop
  • Add your own custom CSS
  • Add your own Elementor template shortcode

One time payment with unlimited updates for the life of the plugin.

Purchase the Pro version here
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “No Results For Elementor” and Install
  3. Activate from your Plugins page
  4. Enable the plugin and modify the settings to fit your needs.
  5. Click on ‘Save Changes’ and you’re DONE!

Note – In order for this to work correctly, you need to setup a post results query through Elementor’s widgets. For example this can be a blog posts feed or a search results page feed, as long as you are using Elementor’s Posts Widget or Archive Posts Widget to output the results.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or newer
  • PHP 7.4 or newer
  • The free Elementor plugin, active

Support

If you find an issue or bug, please email me at info@smdev.au
sections.faq:
Nothing shows up on my search page

Check that the Enable/Disable setting is ticked and that your search results are being output by an Elementor Posts Widget or Archive Posts Widget. The plugin only replaces the “nothing found” message produced by those widgets.

Does this work without Elementor?

No. Elementor must be installed and active.

  • The no results block is now printed only once per page
  • Added a link to the Pro version on the settings screen
  • Added Requires at least, Requires PHP and Requires Plugins headers
